label: prop:metallic-character-knot
title: Metallic character from incomplete sub-Hopf links
html:
Proposition. Metallic character from incomplete sub-Hopf links

Statement. Let \mathcal{A}(p,n) be a stable atom whose electron cloud decomposes as

\mathcal{E} = p \cdot T_{2,3} = S_1 \sqcup \cdots \sqcup S_k \sqcup R,

where each S_i is a closed sub-Hopf link and R is the residual sub-link. The atom \mathcal{A} exhibits metallic character if and only if:

  1. Incompleteness: |R| < 2n_{k+1}^2. The outermost sub-link contains unfilled linking sites.
  2. Low crossing energy: \mathfrak{E}_{\mathrm{cross}}(R) \ll \mathfrak{E}_{\mathrm{cross}}(S_k). The outermost curls wind loosely relative to the inner closed shells.
  3. Site availability: R contains at least one open linking site. The atom permits Hopf linking to an adjacent residual sub-link without disrupting the closed inner shells S_i.
